blocks.heading: People Who Can Finish a Playable Game
rows: Programmer with finished small games
Strong
Game programming is the most common interest in surveys, and teams always need people who can fix performance and bugs.
Artist with one specialty and a playable portfolio
Good
Studios hire for a specific art task, and a build in a game engine proves fit.
Game tester with no second skill
Hard to grow
Entry is easy, but the role is crowded and can be automated in part.
Indie developer or small studio with a niche game
Good with a business layer
Ownership lets income come from sales, ads or contracts.

blocks.heading: Beat a General Game Path
rows: Software or app development
More openings across industries, and game skills transfer in.
Less creative freedom in many roles.
UI/UX or product design
Product teams pay for design that affects sales. See UI/UX design as a career .
Needs research and product thinking.
Video editing and motion for brands
Brands buy this constantly, and results are measurable.
Many people offer it, so niche and results matter.
